question: Estimate the revenue impact of a Bollywood A-lister releasing a movie in opening weekend (box office only).
idealClarificationQuestions: Opening weekend domestic box office for an A-lister release (SRK / Salman / Aamir / Ranbir / Hrithik)? Yes.
Net box office (after entertainment tax / GST)? Yes.
Hindi belt + South dubbed + International revenue? Domestic Hindi belt only.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Screens × opening weekend occupancy × ticket price.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: A-lister release screens: ~5,000-5,500 in Hindi belt.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Seats per show: ~150 (mix of multiplex and single screen).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Gross box office opening weekend: 90L × ₹230 = ~₹210 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Examples: Jawan opening weekend ~₹250 Cr gross; Pathaan ~₹250 Cr; Animal ~₹200 Cr; Stree 2 ~₹130 Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Shows per screen on opening weekend (Fri+Sat+Sun)

calculationFlow: Shows per screen on opening weekend (Fri+Sat+Sun): ~3 days × 5 shows × 5,000 = 75,000 shows.
Gross box office opening weekend: 90L × ₹230 = ~₹210 Cr.
Examples: Jawan opening weekend ~₹250 Cr gross; Pathaan ~₹250 Cr; Animal ~₹200 Cr; Stree 2 ~₹130 Cr.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Examples: Jawan opening weekend ~₹250 Cr gross; Pathaan ~₹250 Cr; Animal ~₹200 Cr; Stree 2 ~₹130 Cr.
